notes.title: Alpha 0.5.3
notes.content:
I'm finally back with a small patch for the game! Significant changes including...


New smartphone pause menu!
Added Time Skip feature
Small improvements to Lighting and Skybox
Adjusted terrain colors
Added Deadbushes
Added Copper
Added new items: Leaf, Water Bottle, Beach Ball, Snowball, Potato, Campfire
New crafting system (WIP)
Small changes to animal behavior
Some other UI tweaks
Small modifications to the generation of ores
Fixed a glitch about planting
And other insignificant changes...

Lastly, there is a satellite looking thing located at the spawn point. What could this mean? You'll find out in the next major update!
https://i.postimg.cc/RFWJSN26/3101340-7.jpg
and with that im gonna go rest now...

notes.title: Alpha 0.5.2
notes.content:
Welcome back to another series of minor insignificant changes yay


 Added action progress system. Some items, you have to hold a button instead of tapping it to perform an action.
 You can kick any dropped item by running over it.
 Added wheat and the ability to make bread by combining wheats
 A fire can be started by hitting a stick with a stick.
 The following items are now flammable: Wheat, Pine sapling, Shrub seed, Stick, Long stick, Coal
 Added "More Info" tab in the inventory screen. With this feature, you can view more information about an item.
 Added an indicator when you try to pick up an item while your pocket is full.
 You can now use shovels and pickaxes as melee weapons. Why? It's funny, that's why.
 Fixed a bug where the world generates shrubs at the same positions no matter what seed the world is.
 Items now emit particles when being cooked
 More funny stamps
 Decreased player height. Don't ask why.
 Added terrain developer tool


That's it for now, because I need to rest. More changes coming soon! See ya! (*＾▽＾)／
